title: History
empty: You haven't run anything yet. What you run from the editor shows up here, grouped by server.
clearConfirm: Clear this machine's whole query history?
connectionGone: The connection “{{name}}” no longer exists: copy the SQL to use it in another one.

tl.noSource: Open a saved query or a project file: its history appears here and changes when you switch tabs.
tl.empty: There are no versions or runs for this tab yet.
tl.emptyFile: This file has no commits or runs yet.
tl.restoredFile: Version restored in the editor: save the file (⌘S) to write it to disk.
tl.noEditor: The tab doesn't have the editor open.
tl.same: It is the same as the current text.
tl.notInCommit: The file wasn't in that commit.
tl.binary: It is not a text file.
tl.tooLarge: The file is too large to compare.
